verdict.rationale: Reducto lists EU/AU data residency endpoints on its pricing page. Its enterprise deployment docs let customers choose dedicated VPC, hybrid VPC, or fully hosted SaaS, with all data and storage in the customer's VPC. Together these give a direct choice of where data is stored. Missing for 10: detailed docs on available regions and how to select a residency endpoint, clarity on which plans include it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: All data and storage reside in the customer’s VPC, while ephemeral processing is handled by Reducto’s dedicated GPU infrastructure.
Customers can choose between a dedicated VPC deployment, a hybrid VPC model, and a fully hosted SaaS model
